title: Planned file writes
responsibility: Preserves planned-file write operations and status formatting, with filesystem effects behind a generation adapter and formatting in a core value leaf.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root for the caller-admitted planned paths; this operation does not independently validate traversal.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.files
inputs.description: Ordered planned paths and contents; existing identical contents are skipped and earlier writes remain if a later item fails.

inputs.name: writePlannedFiles.options
inputs.description: Optional write policy, default {}; force must be truthy to replace differing existing contents.

inputs.name: ensureParents.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to resolve planned destination directories.

inputs.name: ensureParents.files
inputs.description: Planned destinations whose parent directories are created recursively, once per distinct directory.

inputs.name: renderFileList.files
inputs.description: Ordered write results whose status and path are rendered without filesystem access.

outputs.name: writePlannedFiles
outputs.description: Promise of one result per processed planned file, retaining path/contents and created, skipped or overwritten status.

outputs.name: ensureParents
outputs.description: Completes after all distinct planned parent directories exist; returns no data.

outputs.name: renderFileList
outputs.description: Two-space-indented create/skip/overwrite lines in caller order, joined by newlines.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Refuses differing existing contents unless force is enabled; preserves the exact overwrite-refusal message.

errors.name: Filesystem failure
errors.description: Read, write and mkdir exceptions propagate; directory creation and writes are not transactional.
